selection.selection: random.Random(seed).sample(sorted(rows,key=id),15) for old then new; interleave old/new in draw order; sampling without replacement, independent of heuristic flags
scope: Read full problem and solution for every selected row
Judge useful substantive computed contributions and whether each is consumed later
Separate given/alias-only paths from substantive derivations
Flag artificial plus-zero or equivalent padding
Check plan ownership, summary numerical fidelity and final arithmetic in shown target chain
non_goals: No guarantee of full global-context consistency
No proof of causal contribution to MATH-500 score

definitions.given_or_alias_only: A standalone path only copies a given/shared value or propagates equalities; no substantive calculation beyond that alias
definitions.unused_output: A returned output is not consumed by later target calculations or an explicitly planned verification comparison; partner recomputation does not itself consume it
definitions.padding_operation: Artificial neutral arithmetic, e.g. a stated given rewritten as x+0, used to present alias/given work as computation
definitions.useful_verification: Explicitly assigned independent calculation of a meaningful quantity, compared in summary
definitions.clear_scheduling_issue: At least one confirmed given/alias-only path, unused/irrelevant output, artificial neutral-operation padding, or materially unfaithful summary

limitations: 15 per stratum is small; these are sample counts, not exact dataset rates.
Blind means no existing heuristic flags were consulted during selection/manual judgment; source origin and full responses were visible.
Same reviewer, separate re-reading of source arithmetic; no claim of second human reviewer.
No exhaustive global consistency validator was run; incidental negative counts are separately reported, absence of a witness proves nothing.
No inference about causal effect on completed SFT/eval.
Planned independent verification counts as consumption when explicitly compared; identical computation can still have low extra value.
